svg.aria-label: Three nested boxes. The outermost is the deployment — the dtype, sharding and tensor shape a model is served with — which sets the scale of disagreement. Inside it is routing, which replica served a request, worth about three millionths. Innermost is a single trace, where a derived ratio read with both of its terms inside that trace was exactly zero at all fifteen layer-model pairs tested.

g.text: WHAT IT TAKES TO GET THE SAME NUMBER TWICE
three things move a reading off NDIF, and only the innermost one can be made to stop
dtype, sharding, tensor shape — not the model family
sets the scale: the same disagreement reads 5.3e-06 on the 8B and 7.5e-09 on GPT-J, which NDIF serves in float32
which replica answered you, which you do not choose
2026-11-01: sixteen identical readings split eight and eight across two GPUs, 3.11e-06 apart.
Two days later all sixteen landed on one GPU and there was no partition to find.
at all fifteen layer-model pairs tested
Read a ratio with both of its terms live in the same trace and nothing above it reaches the number. Carry one term across traces and both do.
three models, two architectures, depths 0 to 79 · [E-007] through [E-011]
